candidates.name: pair_atlas_schema
candidates.summary: Per-pair, per-move compatibility scores as an evidence layer above the selector (from the STAR survey top-5, 2026-10-26).

candidates.name: merge_hold_handover
candidates.summary: Named compound base: merge, hold, hand over, with hold length from measured stem energy and vocal gaps (from the STAR survey top-5, 2026-10-26).

candidates.name: differentiable_parameter_fitting
candidates.summary: Fit technique parameter defaults from example mixes and freeze them as deterministic defaults — the DJTransGAN method, not its torch stack (from the STAR survey top-5, 2026-10-26).

candidates.name: set_order_layer
candidates.summary: Longest-path set ordering under Camelot-key and energy-flow constraints, run before transition selection (from the STAR survey top-5, 2026-10-26).

candidates.name: selector_output_schema
candidates.summary: Richer selector output: duration_beats, quantize level, curve, fallback duration, reason string, transition-type class, vocal-clash risk, conflict-only EQ plan (from the STAR survey top-5, 2026-10-26). Learn-from only.
